DeterminationBasis: T09-002 directly tests a mandatory predicate changing after a prior gate evaluation and requires stale gate state not to be blindly reused before consequential execution. T10-001 establishes execution-time revalidation of material authority and governance state immediately before execution permission, while T10-002 establishes that material post-determination change invalidates stale permission and requires reevaluation. Together these existing controls establish the required time-of-check / time-of-use protection for relevant conditions that may change between determination and execution.

Existing T08 tests establish determination/execution separation, changed-determination history, missing or ambiguous determination handling, successor preservation, chain-boundary recording, ALLOW semantics and determination-basis attribution. They do not directly establish the normative semantics of HOLD itself: that HOLD preserves non-execution while required information, authority, governing state or evidence remains unresolved. That semantic obligation remains a distinct test gap.
